verdict.rationale: incident.io publishes an API reference that documents endpoints with usage examples, authentication, rate limits and error handling, and offers a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec. There is no evidence of an interactive playground or of examples runnable directly from the docs. The probe 404s only show the spec isn't at common guessed paths; they don't contradict the documented download. missing for 10: interactive try-it/playground evidence, runnable in-browser examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
